body.text: Your Grace was good enough to send {param:last_amount} of {param:last_resource}, {param:months_ago} months ago now, when we had none.
I would not ask again so soon were the need not greater. Our stores are {perception:stores}, and it is {param:lacking} we want this time.
I remember the last time and I have not forgotten who sent it. I would rather say that plainly than have you think I only write when I want something.
You will forgive me for mentioning it. A man in my position learns to say what he is owed before he asks for more.

options.text: and am glad you thought to write
and have looked into the matter
and note you have kept a careful account
and wish I had better to send than words

options.label: tell him there is nothing to send
options.text: There is nothing to send. I will not pretend otherwise and I will not promise what I cannot deliver, which I hope counts for something.

tone.hateful: Kindly keep your accounts to yourself in future.
